<style id="asl-style-inline-css">

    /* Container */
    .author-social-links{
        display:flex;
        gap:14px;
        align-items:center;
        justify-content:center;
        /* remove default link decoration inside */
        line-height:0;
    }
    /* Button look: white rounded square */
    .author-social-links .asl-icon{
        display:inline-flex;
        align-items:center;
        justify-content:center;
        width:32px;
        height:32px;
        border-radius:4px;
        background:#ffffff;
        text-decoration:none;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        transition: transform .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease, background .14s ease;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(2,6,23,0.25); /* soft shadow to lift icons */
    }
    /* spacing for touch */
    .author-social-links .asl-icon:focus{ outline: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(2,6,23,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.03); }
    /* Icon (SVG) color and size */
    .author-social-links .asl-icon svg{
        width:18px;
        height:18px;
        display:block;
        fill: #0B1440; /* deep navy - icon color */
    }
    /* Hover/tap effect */
    .author-social-links .asl-icon:hover{
        transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.06);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(2,6,23,0.32);
    }
    /* optional: slightly different hover hint per brand (subtle) */
    .author-social-links .asl-instagram:hover svg { fill:#0b1440; }
    .author-social-links .asl-linkedin:hover svg  { fill:#0b1440; }
    .author-social-links .asl-reddit:hover svg   { fill:#0b1440; }
    .author-social-links .asl-facebook:hover svg { fill:#0b1440; }
    /* Ensure links inside don't wrap or show underlines */
    .author-social-links .asl-icon { text-decoration:none; }
    .author-social-links .asl-icon img { display:block; }

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">They have a strict refund policy only for new users. Refunds are not available for renewals or returning users. </p>
